selection: Two of 48000 episodes passed the conservative inactivity-plus-delayed-pickup waiting screen. Both used RNG/environment seed267001. This targeted probe tests those exceptions; it does not estimate population performance.
control: Same environment reset, frozen CPU model, stochastic RNG seed and fresh round context. Only L0 takes no-op for the first d steps, then resumes its unchanged recipe expert controller. Baseline must match every original action, reward and event.
hypothesis: Cue-contingent waiting should delay own pickup when the visible cue is delayed. Compare pickup action index with actual cue index.
